# The SocialDM

> The SocialDM is a Phoenix based multifamily marketing agency, founded in 2019 by Michael Shad. It helps apartment communities in Arizona, Nevada, Florida, Oregon and Washington get found on Google Search, Google Maps, social media and AI answers. LocalLift is its weekly visibility program for apartment communities.

Contact: info@thesocialdm.com, 3104 E Camelback Rd #2161, Phoenix AZ 85016.

## Services
- [Multifamily Marketing Agency](https://www.thesocialdm.com/multifamily-marketing-agency): A multifamily marketing agency focused on apartment SEO, Google Maps, reviews, social and AI visibility, so renters find your community before they compare.
- [LocalLift: Google, Maps and AI Visibility for Apartments](https://www.thesocialdm.com/locallift): LocalLift by The SocialDM checks how apartment communities show up on Google Search, Google Maps and AI answers every week, and reports what changed.
- [Medical Practice Marketing and SEO](https://www.thesocialdm.com/medical): AI ready SEO, Google Business Profile care, careful review management and clear service pages that help medical practices become the trusted local choice.
- [Real Estate Agent Marketing and SEO](https://www.thesocialdm.com/real-estate): Social, search and Google Business Profile work that makes real estate agents and teams the name people already trust before the first conversation.
- [Hospitality Marketing and Local SEO](https://www.thesocialdm.com/hospitality): Story led social, Google Maps and search visibility that helps hotels, restaurants, venues and retail brands get found and booked.
- [Multi Location Marketing and SEO](https://www.thesocialdm.com/enterprise): One standard for Google Business Profiles, location pages and AI visibility across every market, with reporting market by market.

## Research
- [The 2026 Multifamily Visibility Report](https://www.thesocialdm.com/2026-multifamily-visibility-report): How apartment communities and lease ups are discovered across social media, Google Search, Google Maps and AI search in 2026, from The SocialDM.
- [Market Intelligence blog](https://www.thesocialdm.com/blog): Research and field notes on how renters find apartments.
